assertion.statement: Cilium cluster name validation is now strictly enforced (max 32 lowercase alphanumeric characters or '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric) for local and remote clusters and can no longer be bypassed.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Evidence does not state which configuration key or value carries the cluster name, so exposure cannot be expressed as a predicate.; consequence: Evidence does not say what happens to a cluster with a non-conforming name (rejection, startup failure, etc.).
